name: Kokapet
title: Kokapet's café road: 52 spots on one 4 km stretch
intro: Streets of Hyderabad, episode 1. One 4 km stretch of Kokapet, from the Gandipet end to Narsingi, with 52 places to eat and drink. Coral pins on our Instagram post are spots with under 200 Google reviews: most of Hyderabad hasn't found them yet.
excludeNote: Ko Ko Kai joined the map after the Instagram post counted 52; kept out so the page matches the post.
